title: Uniti Group Inc. 8-K Filing — Amendment to Articles of Incorporation
summary: Uniti Group Inc. filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 disclosing an amendment to its Second Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation. The amendment changes the notification deadline for electing the method of payment for dividends on its Series A Preferred Stock from the first day of each dividend period to the 10th calendar day immediately preceding the dividend payment date. This is a routine corporate governance/administrative change with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
